class.name: SpriteSheet
class.brief_description: A sprite sheet with named regions of any size.

method.name: add_regions
auto_slice
method.description: Finds every sprite in the image of [member texture] with [method detect_sprite_rects] and adds a region for each one that is not a region yet (no region has exactly that rectangle), named like in [method add_regions]. Returns the names of the new regions. Running it again after new sprites were painted into the sheet adds only the new ones. Fails with an error and returns an empty array if [member texture] is [code]null[/code] or has no image data (see [method Texture2D.get_image]).

method.name: clear_regions
method.description: Removes all regions. [AtlasTexture]s handed out before keep their last values.

method.name: create_sprite_frames
method.description: Builds a [SpriteFrames] resource from the regions whose names start with [param prefix]. The animation name is the region name without its trailing number and without a trailing [code]_[/code], [code]-[/code], [code].[/code] or space: [code]walk_0[/code], [code]walk_1[/code] and [code]walk_10[/code] become the animation [code]walk[/code]. If nothing is left (for example with the prefix [code]walk_[/code]), the prefix without its separator is used. Frames are sorted by their number in numeric order ([code]walk_2[/code] before [code]walk_10[/code]); regions without a number become one-frame animations. Every animation plays at [param fps] frames per second and loops. The frames are the [AtlasTexture]s of [method get_region_texture], so they stay linked to the atlas. The animation [code]"default"[/code] is removed unless a region produces it. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var frames = atlas.create_sprite_frames("hero_", 12.0) $Hero.sprite_frames = frames $Hero.play("hero_walk") [/gdscript] [csharp] SpriteFrames frames = atlas.CreateSpriteFrames("hero_", 12.0); hero.SpriteFrames = frames; hero.Play("hero_walk"); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: detect_sprite_rects
method.description: Returns the bounding rectangles of all sprites in [param image] (the "Auto Slice" of the editor). A pixel is opaque if its alpha is greater than [param alpha_threshold] (0 to 1). Opaque pixels that touch, also diagonally, form one sprite; sprite boxes that overlap or touch afterwards are merged into one. Sprites need at least one transparent pixel between their boxes to stay apart. The rectangles are sorted in rows: top to bottom, and left to right within a row. A row starts with the topmost remaining box and contains every box that starts above its bottom edge. Compressed images are decompressed on a copy; [param image] is not changed.

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns the rectangle of the region [param name] in pixels of [member texture]. Prints an error and returns an empty [Rect2i] if the region does not exist.

method.name: get_region_count
method.description: Returns the number of regions.

method.name: get_region_margin
method.description: Returns the margin of the region [param name] (see [method set_region_margin]). Prints an error and returns an empty [Rect2i] if the region does not exist.

method.name: get_region_names
method.description: Returns the names of all regions, in insertion order.

method.name: get_region_texture
method.description: Returns the [AtlasTexture] of the region [param name]: its [member AtlasTexture.atlas] is [member texture], its [member AtlasTexture.region] the rectangle of the region, its [member AtlasTexture.margin] the margin of the region and its [member AtlasTexture.filter_clip] the value of [member filter_clip]. The texture is created on the first call and then returned again for the same name, so it can be compared and shared. It is updated whenever [member texture], [member filter_clip], the region or its margin changes, and it follows [method rename_region]. If the region is removed, the texture keeps its last values. Prints an error and returns [code]null[/code] if the region does not exist.

method.name: has_region
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a region named [param name] exists.

method.name: import_texture_packer_json
method.description: Replaces all regions with the frames of a TexturePacker JSON file, in the Hash ([code]"frames": {...}[/code]) or Array ([code]"frames": [...][/code]) layout. [code]meta.image[/code] becomes the texture path; a relative path is resolved against [param base_dir] (usually the folder of the JSON file). Frame file names become region names: an image extension is removed and slashes, backslashes, [code]:[/code] and [code]"[/code] become [code]_[/code] (see [method texture_packer_name_to_region_name]). Trimmed frames keep their original size: the offset and the size difference become the margin of the region ([method set_region_margin]). Rotated frames are not supported and make the import fail with an error that names the frame. Multi-texture files ([code]"textures"[/code]) are not supported.

method.name: is_valid_region_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param name] can be used as a region name: not empty, no [code]/[/code], [code]:[/code] or [code]"[/code], no control characters and no leading or trailing spaces.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Reads the file at [param path] and loads it with [method load_from_text] in the format of its extension (see [method ResourceTextSerializer.get_format_from_extension]): [code].json[/code], [code].csv[/code] or [code].ini[/code]. A [code].json[/code] file whose object has a [code]frames[/code] key is imported with [method import_texture_packer_json] instead (relative image paths are resolved against the folder of the file). Returns [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] for other extensions.

method.name: load_from_text
make_grid_rects
method.description: Returns the cells of a uniform grid on an area of [param area_size] pixels, row by row: cells of [param cell_size], starting at [param offset], with [param separation] pixels between two cells. Only cells that lie completely inside the area are returned. Use it with [method add_regions] to cut a sheet into equal sprites. Returns an empty array and prints an error if [param cell_size] is not greater than 0, or if [param separation] or [param offset] is negative.

method.name: make_unique_region_name
method.description: Returns [param prefix] followed by the smallest number from [code]0[/code] up that is not the name of a region yet, for example [code]"sprite_3"[/code]. Returns an empty string and prints an error if [code]prefix + "0"[/code] is not a valid name (see [method is_valid_region_name]).

method.name: remove_region
method.description: Removes the region [param name]. The [AtlasTexture] handed out before for it keeps its last values, and a new region with the same name uses it again.

method.name: rename_region
method.description: Renames the region [param from] to [param to]. The region keeps its position in the order and its [AtlasTexture]. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if [param from] does not exist, [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if [param to] exists, and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param to] is not a valid name.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Writes [method to_text] (with the text-format project settings) to [param path] in the layout of its extension: [code].json[/code], [code].csv[/code] or [code].ini[/code]. Returns [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] for other extensions.

method.name: set_region
set_region_margin
method.description: Sets the margin of the region [param name], used as [member AtlasTexture.margin] of its texture: [member Rect2i.position] is the offset of the region inside the original sprite, [member Rect2i.size] the size the original sprite is larger than the region. This restores the original size of trimmed sprites. All values must be [code]0[/code] or greater.

method.name: texture_packer_name_to_region_name
method.description: Returns the region name used for a TexturePacker frame file name: [code]"hero/walk_01.png"[/code] becomes [code]"hero_walk_01"[/code]. Image extensions ([code]png[/code], [code]jpg[/code], [code]jpeg[/code], [code]webp[/code], [code]bmp[/code], [code]tga[/code], [code]gif[/code], [code]svg[/code], [code]ktx[/code], [code]dds[/code]) are removed; slashes, backslashes, [code]:[/code] and [code]"[/code] become [code]_[/code].

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns the sheet as text in the layout of [param format] described in the class description, with the regions in their order: [constant ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_JSON], [constant ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_CSV] (the margin columns are written only if at least one region has a margin) or [constant ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_INI]. Other formats print an error and return an empty string. Of [param options], only [member SerializerOptions.indent] is used (JSON indentation per level; an empty string writes one line). The layouts are fixed, so the other options do not apply. If [param options] is [code]null[/code], the project settings [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/*[/code] are used. [code]TexturePath[/code] is [member texture_path] if it is set; otherwise the [code]uid://[/code] path of [member texture] if the texture has a UID, otherwise its resource path. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var options = SerializerOptions.new() options.indent = "\t" var json = sheet.to_text(ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_JSON, options) [/gdscript] [csharp] var options = new SerializerOptions { Indent = "\t" }; string json = sheet.ToText(ResourceTextSerializer.Format.Json, options); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

members.member: Value of [member AtlasTexture.filter_clip] for every texture of [method get_region_texture]. If [code]true[/code], the area outside a region is clipped to avoid bleeding of the surrounding pixels.
The margins of the regions that have one (see [method set_region_margin]). Setting this property resets all other margins to zero; names of unknown regions are ignored with an error.
The names of the regions in their order. Only used when saving and loading, because the text resource format sorts the keys of [member regions]; use [method get_region_names] instead.

The regions: sprite name to rectangle [code](x, y, width, height)[/code] in pixels of [member texture], in insertion order. Setting this property replaces all regions; invalid names and empty rectangles are skipped with an error. Rectangles are not checked against [member texture], like regions that a new, smaller texture leaves outside. Regions that keep their name keep their margin and their [AtlasTexture]. A region that comes back under the name of a removed one (for example on undo) gets the [AtlasTexture] of the removed region again, so nodes that use it follow the region. [b]Note:[/b] The returned dictionary is a copy. Use [method set_region] and [method remove_region] to change single regions.

The sprite sheet of this atlas. Any [Texture2D] works ([CompressedTexture2D] of an imported image, [ImageTexture], [GradientTexture2D], [NoiseTexture2D], another [AtlasTexture], ...). Changing it updates every texture of [method get_region_texture] and clears [member texture_path]. Regions outside a new, smaller texture are kept and reported in one error. [b]Note:[/b] Drawing never reads pixels. Only editor features such as thumbnails need [method Texture2D.get_image] to return an image.

The texture path read from the last loaded text file, written back unchanged by [method to_text], so paths with a prefix such as [code]mods://[/code] or [code]uid://[/code] round-trip as text. Empty if [member texture] was set from code.
